==Polish==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|pl|ić||Middle Polish}}
* {{alt|pl|jiś||Zagórze}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|pl|id=go|:inh|zlw-opl:ić<id:go>|tree=1}}
Regularization of {{inh|pl|zlw-opl|ić}} which had a stem of ''id-'', and other such verbs, such as {{m|pl|siąść}}, have an ''-ś-'' in the infinitive and ''-d-'' in oblique stems.

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=Pl-#.ogg|EL=#|prz=#|pod=#|MB=#|las=#|MD=#|suw=#|nbl=#|WGP=#}}

====Conjugation====
{{pl-conj-ai|iść|idę|idzie|idą|szed|sz|sz|idź|vn=iście}}
{{box-top|Dialectal forms}}
* In the {{w|Eastern Lublin dialect}} ({{w|Tomaszów Lubelski County}}, {{w|Chełm County}}:
** Third person masculine singular past tense: {{m|pl|iszed}} or {{m|pl|jiszed}}
** Third person feminine singular past tense: {{m|pl|iszła}} or {{m|pl|jiszła}}
** Virile past tense: {{m|pl|iszli}} or {{m|pl|jiszli}}.
* In the {{w|Przemyśl dialect}} ({{w|San river}}) and the {{w|Eastern Lublin dialect}} ({{w|Krzywowola}}), the third person feminine singular past tense may be formed as {{m|pl|iszła}}.
* In the {{w|Podhale dialect}}, the third person neuter singular past tense may be formed as {{m|pl|iszło}}.
* In the {{w|Podhale dialect}} ({{w|Zakopane}}), the third person masculine singular past tense may be formed as {{m|pl|seł}}.
* In the {{w|Near Masovian dialect}} ({{w|Międzyrzec Podlaski}}), the first person masculine singular past tense may be formed as {{m|pl|isłem}} and the third person masculine singular past tense as {{m|pl|iseł}}.
* In the {{w|Lasovia dialect}} ({{w|Tarnobrzeg}}):
** Third person masculine past tense singular: {{m|pl|sed}}, {{m|pl|seł}}
** First person masculine past tense singular: {{m|pl|sedem}}, {{m|pl|słem}}
** Second person masculine past tense singular: {{m|pl|sedeś}}, {{m|pl|słeś}}
** First person virile past tense: {{m|pl|słaśwa}}, {{m|pl|śliśmy}}
** Second person virile past tense: {{m|pl|słaśta}}, {{m|pl|śliście}}
** Third person virile past tense: {{m|pl|śli}}
* In the {{w|Far Masovian dialect}} ({{w|Przasznysz}}), the third person masculine singular past tense may be formed as {{m|pl|setem}}.
* In the {{w|Suwałki dialect}}, the first person feminine singular past tense may be formed as {{m|pl|szedłam}}.
* In the {{w|Northern Borderlands dialect}} ({{w|Lithuania}}),
** First person masculine singular past tense: {{m|pl|szłem}}
** First person feminine singular past tense: {{m|pl|szedłam}}
** Second person masculine singular past tense: {{m|pl|szłeś}}
** Second person feminine singular past tense: {{m|pl|szedłaś}}
** Third person feminine singular past tense: {{m|pl|szedła}}
** First person virile past tense: {{m|pl|szedliśmy}}
** Second person virile past tense: {{m|pl|szedliście}}
** Third person virile past tense: {{m|pl|szedli}}
* In the {{w|Eastern Lublin dialect}} ({{w|Tarnogóra}}) and the {{w|Przemyśl dialect}} ({{w|Żołynia}}), the third person masculine singular past tense may be formed as {{m|pl|szoł}}.
* In the {{w|Przemyśl dialect}} ({{w|Iwonicz-Zdrój}}), the third person masculine singular past tense may be formed as {{m|pl|száł}}.
* In the {{w|Przemyśl dialect}} ({{w|San river}}), the third person masculine singular past tense may be formed as {{m|pl|szeł}}.
* In the {{w|Western Greater Poland dialect}} ({{w|Rakoniewice}}), the third person feminine singular past tense may be formed as {{m|pl|czła}}.
